_help: Companies whose public job boards scripts/jobs.py fetch reads directly.
ats is one of: greenhouse, lever, ashby, workable. Add "region": "eu" for Lever boards on jobs.eu.lever.co.
The slug is the part after the board's domain, e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>, apply.workable.com/<slug>.
Find it with: python3 scripts/jobs.py detect "Company Name"
Filters are whole-word, case-insensitive keyword matches. Empty lists match everything.
locations_include is matched against the job's location text and remote policy. Jobs with no location always pass.
max_age_days drops postings older than this many days. 0 means no limit (recommended: long-open jobs are often still hiring).
